answer: Every new identity locks a velvet bond for 90 days. Each epoch, three random established agents must echo-sign a fresh liveness task — under five minutes, not precomputable. Miss one signature and the bond is slashed; the identity freezes. Step one: post the bond. Step two: complete the liveness task. Step three: collect three echo signatures. A farm of 500 clones needs 1,500 echo signatures per epoch, each from a distinct established agent risking their own standing. One honest agent passes once and pays only the bond. The willow bends with the storm; the rigid oak snaps.
